questions.question:
Auxin and phototropism.

An upright shoot receives light from the right. Explain how it comes to bend right.
questions.answer: Auxin from the shoot tip becomes more concentrated on the shaded left side. Auxin stimulates shoot cell elongation. Cells on the left elongate more, so the left side grows longer. Unequal growth curves the shoot towards the right-hand light.
